selection: Rank eligible native paths by SHA256(seed + repository + path), before detector use; choose first target count. Do not replace source based on findings.

path_policy.python: complete .py modules under each declared source prefix; exclude __init__.py; nonempty UTF-8 at most 100000 bytes; no execution
path_policy.markdown: complete root README.md, unchanged native UTF-8
path_policy.holdout: cache/validate bytes automatically; do not display holdout prose or run detector before independently frozen review

groups.dialect: README; embedded HTML supported only by extraction contract
README; embedded HTML supported only by extraction contract

limitations: Purpose-selected open-source Python projects; bounded source-group pilot, no genre or population representativeness claim. Known repository identity isolation only; overlapping contributors can remain unknown. Original 300-unit manifest and freeze remain unchanged.
